claim_text: Architected a governed policy-gated agent execution surface for enterprise AI workflows, combining L0 route-policy dispatch, multi-agent orchestration contracts, and human override escalation paths to keep production agents auditable and controllable.

Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing usage-based subscription forecasting with partner deal support to expand recurring enterprise engagement.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by instituting evaluation gates, telemetry instrumentation, and rollback controls across production agent execution.
Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks through replayable runtime design.

Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating Databricks Lakehouse data pipelines and dense-sparse retrieval design across cloud-native execution layers.
Scaled the platform engineering team from 8 to 28 while converting bespoke client delivery into reusable AI platform IP through an operating model built for agentic platform commercialization.
